column1: This release uses the application's 631 canonical roles: 657 source-current records map to 655 MASCO 2020 identities, and the approved alias table consolidates 24 duplicate identities. Global standards enrich these roles without adding new ones. Prewritten answers have been removed from Role Questions, General Questions, and Open Questions.

Choose the target role in MASCO Roles, then select General, Role-specific, or Mixed using Session Blueprints. Use AI Evaluation Rubric to assess the user's transcript and generate evidence-linked feedback; do not compare the response to a model answer. Review title-similarity mappings and technical question links before production, confirm MASCO redistribution rights, preserve source licences, and complete domain, fairness, accessibility, and local legal review.
